QuestInfo.name: [Celestial] The Longest Night
QuestInfo.0:
#e<Unending Night>#n

A massive solar eclipse has cast a shadow over Maple World. With the boundary between night and day blurred, many aren't even sure what day it is.

Under the shroud of endless night, complete daily quests to receive #egreatly increased rewards#n! Talk to Nocturna to learn the special ability that makes it all possible.

#b* You must select #eUnending Night#n as your weekly event to proceed.#k

#b#e[Event Period]#k#n
08/26/2020 12:00 AM - 
09/22/2020 11:59 PM UTC
